extension.description: Automatically selects preferred-language Signs/Songs/Forced subtitle tracks on episode transitions. Extends Kodi's forced_only mode to also pick up tracks named "signs", "songs", or "forced" that aren't flagged as forced in the container. Reads your preferred subtitle language directly from Kodi's own subtitle settings — no separate configuration needed.
extension.news: v0.5.0 - Source of truth for preferred language is now Kodi's own ``subtitles.languages`` setting (read via JSON-RPC). No separate addon setting to drift out of sync — change it in Kodi's Player > Subtitles UI and this addon respects it immediately. Falls back to the Kodi UI locale if the setting is empty. - Broadened the language normalization map (~25 common languages) so non-English anime muxes with multi-language Forced/Signs tracks are filtered correctly. - Kodi's ``forced_only`` mode auto-picks the first forced-flagged track by stream index regardless of language (e.g. Portuguese (Forced) at index 0). This addon now detects that case and disables the non-preferred forced track before scanning for a preferred-language match, rather than leaving you on a forced track in a language you don't read. - Stale-index guard now validates the reported current index against the actual stream list for THIS file, not just index > 0. v0.4.0 - Only auto-select tracks in the configured preferred subtitle languages (English by default). This prevents a similarly named Forced or Signs/Songs track in another language from overriding the intended subtitle, and disables an automatically selected non-preferred forced track. v0.3.0 - Fix auto-select skipped on episode transitions. Kodi reports a stale `currentsubtitle.index` for tens of ms after onAVStarted (carry-over from the previous file), which fooled the 'don't override user choice' guard. The guard now also requires `subtitleenabled=true`, which is the reliable signal that Kodi has resolved the new file's subtitle state. When forced_only finds no flagged forced track on the new file, Kodi disables subtitles entirely — addon now correctly fires in that case. v0.2.0 - Add 'forced' to default keywords so tracks named 'Forced' (e.g. anime release-group variants like 'Forced (freeka)', 'Forced (Doki)') are auto-selected even when the MKV container does not set the forced flag bit. Kodi's forced_only locale mode only matches the flag bit, not the track name, so authored 'Forced' tracks without the bit were being skipped. v0.1.0 - Initial release. Auto-selects Signs/Songs subtitle tracks on playback start.
